body.x: Ippims will be participating inMIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT in CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the world'slargest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11(Fri) # 52843) and exhibit a 'patent research request matching platform'.

Ippims is a company that presentsnew perspectives to the existing patent research market. It provides researchservice reflecting the needs of customers in various fields such as freeresearch, infringement research, and subject research. Ippims 'patent searchrequest matching platform' system identifies researchers and presents expertsbased on the researcher's experience and the subject of the research.

The existing Korean researchmarket is based on the trust of clients and researchers, but this trust isdifficult to sustain for a long time due to several requests for research anddisappointments. As a result, the research market is repeating the creation anddestruction of new research companies and pushes excellent researchers tobecome managers. The service of Ippims is to stop this wasteful repetition andto provide customers with trust and satisfaction in depth of empirical andappropriate inquiry for the investigator.

Ippims' patent researchcommission matching platform provides users with a list of appropriateresearchers by their technology and matches the appropriate investigatorthrough the application form and the invention report. It also evaluates theappropriateness of the request for research, explores easy prior art, and linksthe optimal patent application through the research report. Users can acquiredeeper levels of reports through this platform and have the advantage ofmatching researchers from different perspectives.

Participating in the CES withDaejeon Information & Culture Industry Promotion Agency, Ippims willintroduce technologies to buyers and investors worldwide with the US, Europe,Japan, China, and Southeast Asian markets in mind. In the future, Ippims willexplore and educate highly educated researchers with field experience. Inaddition to this, we are proposing a new approach to patent access to users byusing patent database and provide one-stop service through linkage with patentoffices as well as research reports.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third eveningof the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held.In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated byAVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company.CES 2019 is an innovative exhibition where technologycompanies that will lead the fourth industrial revolution will participate. Themain categories are 3D Printing, Accessibility, Advertising, Marketing, Contentand Entertainment, AR / VR and Gaming, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics,Audio and Video , Baby Tech, CES Sports Zone, Country Pavilions, Design &Source Showcase, Digital Money, Drones, Enterprise Solutions, Eureka Park,Family and Kids Tech, Fitness, Health and Wellness, Home Cinema, IoTInfrastructure, iProducts , Resilience, Self-Driving Technology, Sleep Tech,Smart Cities, Smart Home, Sports Tech, Tourism, Vehicle Technology, Wearables,Wireless Devices and Services.
